findings.problem: The acceptance matrix requires agreement with the last known good function but does not explicitly require agreement with the written contract or define what to do if the two disagree. A refactor could pass all eight comparisons while preserving behavior that violates the contract.
findings.example: For lock off, quote fresh, and session closed, require false under the written contract. If the last known good function returns true, block rollout until the discrepancy is resolved.
